name: Arcana Apprentice Tale: The Dancing Rodent
source:
Nadia summons Miyara and Julian to the palace to discuss the newest rumor in Vesuvius. What is a dancing rodent? Does it really eat children?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
